articles.title: Beloved Texas chiropractor killed in Grand Canyon flash flood, 2 friends still missing after hike
articles.summary: Texas chiropractor Dr. John Giusti was killed in a Grand Canyon flash flood while hiking companions Brent Rosenkranz and Tim Smith remain missing, according to family and friends.
articles.body: A beloved Texas chiropractor and father of three who disappeared during devastating flash flooding at the Grand Canyon has died, his former chiropractic practice announced Monday. Dr. John Giusti, of Granbury, Texas, had been exploring the Grand Canyon when a flash flood tore through Bright Angel Creek on Aug. 29, turning what his wife described as a "lifetime dream" into tragedy. "We are heartbroken to make this update. Dr. John was one of the victims of the Grand Canyon flooding," Whipple City Family Chiropractic, where Giusti previously practiced for eight years, announced on Facebook. "John was a real-life superhero to everyone blessed enough to know him," Janet Giusti wrote in a tribute shared on the fundraiser. PARK VISITORS FACE FLOOD DANGER OUT WEST WHILE SEVERE STORMS RIP THROUGH NY, NJ Photos posted to Giusti’s ChiroHabit business page also show him in the Grand Canyon before the flooding began. Janet remembered her husband as a dedicated chiropractor who "truly lived to treat and heal," but said his most cherished role was being a father. "Beyond his practice, he was a man of electric energy and boundless passion---an avid runner, an enthusiast of fast cars, and a massive fan of comic books and legendary heroes," she wrote. "Yet out of all the titles he carried, his absolute favorite was being a devoted father to his three beautiful girls." ARIZONA STATE STUDENT VANISHES DURING GRAND CANYON TRIP JUST DAYS BEFORE GRADUATION, FAMILY PLEADS FOR HELP Janet said her husband was fulfilling a longtime dream when the deadly flood struck. "John was living out a lifetime dream exploring the majesty of the Grand Canyon when tragedy struck," she wrote. "On August 29, 2026, a sudden flash flood swept through Bright Angel Creek, tragically taking him from us while he was immersed in an adventure he had longed for." GRAND CANYON MYSTERY ILLNESS REPORTEDLY TRIGGERS NPS INVESTIGATION AFTER RAFTERS REPORT ALARMING SYMPTOMS While describing the family's grief as "as vast and profound as the canyon itself," Janet said they were finding some solace in how John spent his final moments. "We find a small comfort in knowing he spent his final moments surrounded by breathtaking beauty, living life to the fullest," she wrote. Her tribute ended with a heartbreaking description of the different roles Giusti played in the lives of those around him. "To the community, he was a gifted healer. To his friends, a powerhouse of life. To his daughters, he was their ultimate hero. To me, he was my whole world," Janet wrote. The National Park Service has not publicly identified the approximately 15 people it is working to locate or account for, and officials have not confirmed Giusti’s name. The agency is asking anyone who knows of hikers or backpackers who were in the Bright Angel Creek corridor on Aug. 29 or who had a campground reservation there to contact investigators. Whipple City Family Chiropractic separately announced it was collecting donations at its Greenwich and Cambridge offices and would match the contributions to provide immediate support to the Giusti family. Giusti practiced chiropractic care for 19 years and was a partner at Whipple City Family Chiropractic in New York for eight years before moving to Granbury in 2020, according to his business biography. He and Janet were raising their threedaughters in Texas. ARMY BLACK HAWKS AIRLIFT 200-PLUS STRANDED CAMPERS AS MISSOURI FLOODS TRIGGER MORE 350 RESCUES Giusti was not alone in the canyon when the flooding struck. Loved ones identified the other two members of his hiking group as Brent Rosenkranz and Tim Smith, saying both men remained missing Monday as search-and-rescue efforts continued. Rosenkranz had posted selfies from the Grand Canyon before the flooding, tagging Giusti and sharing his excitement about the grueling adventure ahead. "Just arrived at the Grand Canyon. Will be hiking over 31 miles next four days with vertical change of over a mile," Rosenkranz wrote. "Carrying a 40 lb backpack. This should be an adventure!" Rosenkranz joked that his fear of heights would likely make the trip even more memorable. "Most of you know don't handle heights," he wrote. "So I should have lots of funny stories when I get back." The post offered a glimpse of the group's trip before flash flooding tore through Bright Angel Creek. Tina Newberry, whose daughter co-owns the ATA Glen Rose martial arts location, said Giusti had been exploring the canyon with fellow "ATA fathers" Rosenkranz and Smith when disaster struck. "At this time, Brent and Tim remain missing, and search and rescue teams continue working to locate them," Newberry wrote in a public Facebook post. Newberry said Rosenkranz is the husband of Elisha Rosenkranz and that the couple is deeply connected to ATA martial arts schools in Granbury, Cleburne and Glen Rose, Texas. She described Smith as a husband and father of three children who attend the schools. "This tragedy is touching four ATA school communities---students, parents, instructors, and team members who know and love these families," Newberry wrote. "Please keep all of them, along with the search and rescue teams, in your thoughts and prayers." "We continue to hold onto hope and pray in faith for Brent and Tim to be found," she added. The flash flood began at about 2:30 p.m. on Aug. 29, according to the National Park Service. As of Sunday morning, 62 people had been evacuated from Phantom Ranch and the lower North Kaibab Trail, and no injuries had been reported. Nearly all footbridges across Bright Angel Creek were destroyed, cutting off hiker access across the waterway. The flooding also forced the closure of Phantom Ranch, Bright Angel Campground, the North Kaibab Trail to Phantom Ranch, Black Bridge, Silver Bridge and the Colorado River to river traffic. EXPERTS ZERO IN ON LIKELY CAUSE OF DEADLY NEPAL MUDSLIDE, WITH MORE THAN 1,400 MISSING Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs said her "heart is with the families and loved ones of every person unaccounted for after the flash flooding at the Grand Canyon." Hobbs said the Arizona Division of Emergency Management is coordinating with the National Park Service and Coconino County Emergency Management to support search and recovery efforts. articles.title: ‘For a more inclusive campus’: In a first, a visually impaired student in Dusu race
articles.summary: Delhi University DUSU polls may see first visually impaired central panel candidate as ASAP considers law student Pankaj Dhingra; elections on Sept 18.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: For the first time in the history of Delhi University Students’ Union (Dusu) elections, a visually impaired student may enter the fray for the central panel, with Pankaj Dhingra likely to be a candidate from AAP’s student outfit, ASAP.Dhingra, a first-year LLB student at Campus Law Centre and a Kirori Mal College (KMC) graduate, has been associated with AAP for three years. He was the secretary of the students’ union at KMC and has been active in raising issues concerning persons with disabilities (PwD). He told TOI he has around 5-10% vision and described his condition as “late blindness”, with his vision beginning to deteriorate when he was in classes V-VI.The lack of representation of PwD students in DU’s student bodies was a major reason motivating him to contest, Dhingra said. Lack of tactile infrastructure, commuting difficulties and problems faced by visually impaired students in finding examination scribes are among key issues he wants to raise.“Students are appointed as scribes but aren’t paid remuneration for a long time. Because of this, visually impaired students face difficulty in finding people to write their exams. It’s also tough to find suitable subject-matter experts as scribes,” he said.Dhingra participated in the CJP-led stir at Jantar Mantar under the ASAP banner and alleged he was lathicharged. He also expressed solidarity with students following the death of an IIT Delhi student.The probable ASAP panel includes former NSUI state secretary Janhvi Kataria; AAP MLA Kuldeep Kumar’s nephew Abhishek Kumar; Kunal Tyagi, son of MCD councillor Pinky Tyagi; and Ashmit Panwar.Tyagi, a second-year LLB student and graduate of Motilal Nehru College, joined ASAP last year after it was relaunched. His father, Naresh Tyagi, is a district president. Kumar, a BA graduate of Shyam Lal College who is seeking admission to an MA in Buddhist Studies, was appointed state vice-president when the student outfit was relaunched. He is being projected as the Dalit representative.Kataria, an ARSD College graduate and a Najafgarh resident, joined ASAP four months ago after spending around four years with NSUI. The lone woman among the probables, she is being projected as a representative of students from outlying areas who face long daily commutes to DU. Panwar, a first-year PGDAV College student, is a recent entrant to ASAP.ASAP state vice-president Kamal Tiwari said the decision to field a visually impaired student was a “conscious step” towards meaningful representation for students with disabilities, adding the aim was to create a more “inclusive and representative campus”.The final list will be clear once the nomination and withdrawal process is completed after Sept 11.Meanwhile, RSS-affiliated ABVP announced a list of 13 probables -- Alok Attri, Ayushi Sharma, Ishu Maurya, Krishna Yadav, Lakshya Raj Singh, Nitin Tanwar, Priyanshu Mahamana, Riya Chhawri, Riya Malik, Sunny Dedha, Tanya Mavi, Varun Yadav and Yash Dabas. articles.title: Holy Cross: School dispute was 'hatred at its worst' says Priest
articles.summary: Fr Aidan Troy says the "hurt" of that ordeal in 2001 in north Belfast could happen again.
articles.body:
The priest who helped shield schoolgirls during the 2001 Holy Cross dispute has said the "hurt" of that ordeal could happen again.

Speaking on the 25th anniversary of Holy Cross, Fr Aidan Troy said that possibility is what keeps him "devoted to dialogue, to conversation, to searching for justice and to caring about people".

Fr Aidan said the sectarian dispute was "hatred at its worst".

It happened in north Belfast when loyalist protesters tried to block the route taken by Holy Cross school pupils and their parents, who were from a Catholic background, on their walk to class.

Following the initial violence, the police and Army put up crash barriers to keep a corridor route open for the Holy Cross pupils.

The images of terrified schoolgirls having to run the gauntlet between lines of armoured police officers in order to get to their primary school were beamed around the world.

Protestants claimed that Catholics were attacking their homes and said the school protest was their way of highlighting their concerns.

Stones, bottles, fireworks and even a blast bomb were thrown during weeks of unrest.

Fr Aidan, who was parish priest in Ardoyne at the time, told BBC News NI that "none of us want to see hatred".

"Hatred is the rawest, smelliest, most awful thing that anyone stood in the middle of," he said.

"We tell this story, not to blame, but to say we are capable of doing this to each other but let's make a commitment that we never will and we'll not do anything that would ever demean the way those children were demeaned."

He said people come up to him and thank him for what he did.

"I am embarrassed because I didn't do anything really worthwhile," he said.

"People say their children were given dignity. They were worth going in the front door and they were worth fighting for, and you stood in the middle of the road and said so."

"The shock of Holy Cross, even 25 years later, probably means that it probably would not happen [again] in the exact same form, but the hurt is always possible," he said.

About 100 pupils needed counselling due to their daily ordeal, according to principal at the time, Anne Tanney.

Speaking to the BBC in 2004 , she said that even as an adult, she was traumatised by the protests .

"There were times when I couldn't eat, couldn't sleep," she said. "I used to bite my lip, trying not to cry in front of the children."

articles.body:
A preparação da casa para o verão costuma começar meses antes da chegada da estação. Em setembro, áreas externas, piscinas, varandas, cozinhas, banheiros e espaços gourmet entram no planejamento de quem deseja concluir melhorias antes das férias e das confraternizações de fim de ano.

Áreas externas e espaços de convivência estão entre os principais focos das reformas realizadas antes do verão — Foto: Internet

Cada espaço pede uma análise específica. Áreas expostas ao sol, à chuva e à umidade exigem revestimentos resistentes e de fácil manutenção. Em cozinhas e banheiros, a escolha correta de pisos, metais, louças e acabamentos contribui para uma rotina mais prática e ajuda a preservar os materiais mesmo com o uso frequente.

Também é importante pensar na relação entre os ambientes. Quando cores, revestimentos e demais elementos são definidos de forma coordenada, a casa ganha uma leitura mais equilibrada e o projeto avança com menos ajustes de última hora.

articles.title: Vai trabalhar no feriado de 7 de setembro? Saiba o que diz a lei | G1
articles.standfirst: Quem for escalado para trabalhar no feriado pode ter direito a pagamento em dobro ou a uma folga compensatória, conforme as regras aplicáveis.
articles.summary: Quem for escalado para trabalhar no feriado pode ter direito a pagamento em dobro ou a uma folga compensatória, conforme as regras aplicáveis.
articles.body:
Agosto mal terminou e muitos trabalhadores já estão de olho no tão esperado “feriadão” que chega na próxima segunda-feira (7): o Dia da Independência do Brasil .

A data, considerada feriado nacional pela Consolidação das Leis do Trabalho (CLT), garante aos funcionários um dia de descanso.

Celebrado em 7 de setembro, o feriado marca a Independência do Brasil, proclamada em 1822, quando o país rompeu seus laços coloniais com Portugal.

Como a data cai em uma segunda-feira, quem folga aos fins de semana poderá ter três dias seguidos de descanso — de sábado a segunda-feira.

Enquanto alguns trabalhadores terão a oportunidade de aproveitar o feriado, outros seguirão trabalhando normalmente. A legislação permite o funcionamento de atividades em setores considerados essenciais. (veja quais abaixo)

⚠️ Mas atenção: quem for escalado para trabalhar no feriado tem direito a receber em dobro ou a uma folga compensatória. O g1 conversou com especialistas em direito trabalhista para explicar como funcionam as regras.

🤔 Meu chefe pode me obrigar a trabalhar durante o feriado?

💰 Remuneração em dobro ou folga? Quem define?

❌ Faltei ao trabalho, apesar de ter sido escalado. Posso ser demitido por justa causa?

⚠️ As regras são diferentes para empregado fixo e temporário?

✍🏼 Como funciona no caso do trabalhador intermitente?

📆 Quais são os próximos feriados de 2026?

Praia de Copacabana no feriado de 7 de Setembro — Foto: Marcos Serra Lima/g1

1. Meu chefe pode me obrigar a trabalhar durante o feriado?

Sim. Apesar de o artigo 70 da CLT proibir atividades profissionais durante feriados nacionais, a legislação abre exceções para serviços considerados essenciais , como setores de indústria, comércio, transportes, comunicações, serviços funerários, atividades ligadas à segurança, entre outros.

Além disso, o empregador pode solicitar que o funcionário trabalhe durante o feriado quando houver uma Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho, que é um acordo antecipado feito entre empregadores e sindicatos.

Para quem é obrigado a trabalhar no feriado, a legislação garante o pagamento da remuneração em dobro ou compensação com folga em outro dia .

" Havendo banco de horas também poderão ser lançadas estas horas de trabalho, nos termos do acordo individual ou coletivo", explica Ana Gabriela Burlamaqui, advogada trabalhista e sócia do A. C Burlamaqui Consultores.

3. Remuneração em dobro ou folga? Quem define?

A definição do tipo de compensação (seja através do pagamento em dobro ou concessão de folga compensatória) geralmente é determinada durante o acordo feito entre empregador e sindicato.

Na ausência da Convenção Coletiva de Trabalho, a decisão pode ser negociada entre empregador e funcionário. No entanto, é importante que as duas partes estejam de acordo e que a compensação escolhida esteja em conformidade com a legislação.

"O empregador não pode decidir de forma unilateral. Se houver um acordo ou convenção coletiva prevendo a compensação por folga, essa regra prevalece; caso não exista, o pagamento em dobro pelo trabalho no feriado é obrigatório", afirma Elisa Alonso, advogada trabalhista e sócia do RCA Advogados.

4. Faltei ao trabalho, apesar de ter sido escalado. Posso ser demitido por justa causa?

Depende. A falta pode ser entendida como insubordinação, que é a desobediência a um superior.

"Mas a dispensa por justa causa, em geral, não decorre de um fato isolado, mas de um comportamento faltoso de forma reiterada", afirma Ana Gabriela Burlamaqui, advogada trabalhista.

Com isso, a demissão por justa causa geralmente segue um processo que deve incluir uma soma de advertências escritas e tentativas de correção de comportamento.

Em caso de expediente normal, o empregado poderá sofrer outras penalidades administrativas como o desconto do dia não trabalhado, que será considerado falta injustificada.

"A falta injustificada deve ser repreendida, no entanto, para fins de justa causa, é necessário que outros fatores sejam analisados, como a recorrência da conduta, o impacto causado à empresa e a função desempenhada pelo empregado, por exemplo", completa a advogada trabalhista Elisa Alonso.

5. As regras são diferentes para empregado fixo e temporário?

As regras básicas sobre trabalho em feriados aplicam-se tanto a empregados fixos quanto temporários, incluindo o direito ao pagamento em dobro ou folga compensatória .

No entanto, contratados por meio de vínculo de trabalho temporário podem ter pré-condições específicas.

6. Como funciona no caso do trabalhador intermitente?

Para o trabalhador que é contratado em regime de trabalho intermitente (previsão legal inserida na CLT pela Reforma Trabalhista de 2017), o pagamento em feriados deve ser acordado no momento da admissão .

O contrato deve especificar o valor da hora de trabalho, que já deve considerar os adicionais devidos por trabalho em feriados ou horas extras.

Dessa forma, o trabalhador intermitente receberá o valor que foi combinado para os dias trabalhados, incluindo feriados, aponta o advogado Luís Nicoli.

7. Quais são os próximos feriados de 2026?

Depois de setembro, a próxima oportunidade de emenda será no feriado de 12 de outubro , Dia de Nossa Senhora Aparecida, padroeira do Brasil. A data também marca o Dia das Crianças.

O feriado cairá novamente em uma segunda-feira , o que permitirá três dias seguidos de descanso para os trabalhadores que folgam aos fins de semana.

Quem for escalado para trabalhar terá direito, em regra, ao pagamento em dobro ou a uma folga compensatória.

articles.title: Como é rotina de trisal com rainha de rodeio, irmã e agricultor | G1
articles.standfirst: Juntos há seis anos, eles dividem a convivência de forma setorizada. Agricultor conta que dois filhos e uma enteada moram com eles, em Montividiu.
articles.summary: Ao g1, Maycon e Lara explicaram a dinâmica do sobrado onde vivem em Goiás, a divisão dos quartos e como organizam a convivência familiar e a criação dos filhos.
articles.body:
Morando em uma casa de dois andares em Montividiu , no sudoeste de Goiás, o trisal formado pela rainha de rodeio Lara Alves Rueda, de 35 anos, a irmã gêmea dela, Laila, e o agricultor Maycon Rueda, de 43 anos, detalhou ao g1 a logística do dia a dia a três. Juntos há seis anos, eles dividem a convivência de forma setorizada : as irmãs ocupam pavimentos separados do imóvel e Maycon alterna as noites em cada quarto.

Ao g1 , Lara explicou que ocupa a parte de baixo porque gosta da cozinha enquanto Laila fica no piso superior. "Eu fiquei com a parte de baixo porque gosto de cozinha. Em cima não tem cozinha, é só quarto, então a família come toda junto", explicou a rainha de rodeio.

Maycon explicou que cada um dos três tem um filho de relacionamentos anteriores, sendo que dois vivem em outras cidades. “Só a filha da Lara que mora com a gente”, contou. Lara e Laila também tiveram, cada uma, um filho com Maycon. Assim, três crianças moram com o trisal.

Trisal formado por rainha de rodeio, irmã gêmea e agricultor tem filhos e está há 6 anos junto: 'A gente é muito feliz’ — Foto: Arquivo pessoal - Maycon Rueda/Jam Carlos

Lara Alves Rueda, de 35 anos, vive trisal com a irmã gêmea e agricultor, em Goiás — Foto: Arquivo pessoal/Maycon Rueda

De acordo com a rainha de rodeio, após namorar o agricultor por dois anos e romper a relação, a irmã, Laila, o namorou por quatro anos até propor que os três passassem a viver juntos.

Em entrevista ao g1 , Laila admitiu que o início da convivência a três foi desafiador e marcado por ciúmes, mas destacou que o trio construiu harmonia com o passar dos anos. Ela completou que eles moravam em casas vizinhas antes de se mudarem para o sobrado atual, há dois meses.

Apesar da curiosidade inicial dos moradores de Montividiu, o trio sempre contou com a aceitação dos familiares. O agricultor reforçou que as dúvidas sobre o cotidiano superam os julgamentos. "O que eu mais escuto é curiosidade sobre como tudo funciona. Nunca imaginei ficar famoso por isso. Claro que tem críticas, mas é algo normal diante de um relacionamento fora do padrão", pontuou.

O trisal repercutiu nas redes sociais depois que Lara deu uma entrevista no sábado (29), falando sobre o relacionamento. Ela foi rainha do rodeio da Expo Montividiu de 2026, que aconteceu entre os dias 21 e 29 de agosto.

Laila contou que ficou abalada com os ataques e julgamentos após a história viralizar, mas decidiu não ler os comentários para preservar a família.

"A gente divide o mesmo homem, só que não tem bagunça, não tem nada do que o povo pensa. Aonde a gente vai, a gente respeita todo mundo e todo mundo respeita a gente", explicou.

articles.title: Enchentes no Nepal viram teste crucial para governo Gen Z | G1
articles.standfirst: Tragédia que deixou centenas de mortos colocam à prova a liderança do primeiro-ministro e ex-rapper Balendra Shah. Críticos apontam falhas na coordenação e demora nos resgates.
articles.summary: Tragédia que deixou centenas de mortos colocam à prova a liderança do primeiro-ministro e ex-rapper Balendra Shah. Críticos apontam falhas na coordenação e demora nos resgates.
articles.body:
O primeiro-ministro do Nepal , Balendra Shah, um ex-rapper popularmente conhecido como "Balen", enfrenta a enorme tarefa de reconstruir comunidades e infraestruturas essenciais após as violentas enchentes que atingiram o país na semana passada.

A enxurrada, que continha rochas, gelo, lama e detritos, varreu áreas próximas à fronteira com a China, devastando cidades inteiras e causando danos a usinas hidrelétricas.

Mais de 900 pessoas morreram e quase 4,8 mil estão desaparecidas, informaram as autoridades nesta segunda-feira (31), quando os esforços de resgate entraram no sexto dia.

As enchentes atingiram o país do Himalaia poucos dias antes do aniversário dos protestos anticorrupção liderados pela Geração Z, ocorridos entre 8 e 9 de setembro do ano passado, que derrubaram o governo anterior e levaram Shah ao poder.

Agora, o primeiro-ministro de 36 anos e o gabinete dele, em grande parte inexperiente, enfrentam a primeira grande crise nacional, naquele que parece estar se tornando o pior desastre do país na última década.

Casas destruídas por avalanche no Nepal em 26 de agosto de 2026 — Foto: Navesh Chitrakar/REUTERS

As equipes de resgate, incluindo especialistas chineses e indianos, acreditam que centenas de trabalhadores estejam presos em túneis de usinas hidrelétricas em construção que foram soterradas pela lama devido às inundações.

Sushila Giri aguardava notícias do filho, Sishir, um estudante da Universidade de Katmandu que estava realizando um estágio em um dos projetos hidrelétricos.

"Fiquei sabendo que meu filho, junto com outras pessoas, estava no alojamento do projeto hidrelétrico quando ocorreu o desastre", conta ela à DW. "Por favor, me ajudem a descobrir onde ele está."

Raksha Bam, ativista da Geração Z, expressou preocupação com os atrasos no resgate dos trabalhadores presos em obras de hidrelétricas e instou o governo a buscar assistência especializada da comunidade internacional.

Em todos os distritos afetados, familiares se reuniram em hospitais e centros de assistência temporária na esperança de receber notícias de parentes desaparecidos.

Indra Adhikari perdeu nas enchentes sua casa e seus arrozais, e quatro dos parentes dela estão desaparecidos. Ela reclamou que os esforços de resgate e assistência pareciam estar concentrados em áreas acessíveis por estrada e onde a imprensa estava presente, especialmente ao longo da margem do rio Trishuli.

"A maioria das pessoas que vieram para Trishuli Bazar não são socorristas, mas sim curiosos", afirma ela à DW. "Os povoados remotos, mais a montante e do outro lado do rio, continuam de difícil acesso."

Crise pega nova liderança do país de surpresa

Balendra Shah em 26 de março de 2026 — Foto: PRAKASH MATHEMA / AFP

O próprio governo reconheceu que não estava totalmente preparado para um desastre dessa magnitude – o mais mortal do Nepal desde o terremoto de 2015.

"No primeiro dia, ficamos um pouco confusos sobre como lidar com a crise", disse o ministro da Informação e Comunicação, Bikram Timilsina, à DW após visitar a área atingida pelas enchentes. .

"[A partir do] segundo dia, temos dedicado todos os nossos esforços às rápidas operações de busca, resgate e assistência humanitária."

As agências de segurança foram elogiadas pela capacidade de reação, especialmente pelos esforços para chegar às pessoas em áreas de difícil acesso por meio de helicópteros. No entanto, o desastre também levantou questões sobre a capacidade da liderança nepalesa de gerenciar crises e sua relação com os governos provinciais e locais do Nepal .

"Dada a magnitude da tragédia, os esforços e a rapidez do governo para lidar com a crise são louváveis", afirma Madhu Raman Acharya, ex-secretário de Relações Exteriores do Nepal , à DW.

"Os esforços preliminares de busca e resgate, especialmente a coordenação entre as agências de segurança, são louváveis."

Govinda Pokharel, ex-diretor executivo da Autoridade Nacional de Reconstrução, que supervisionou os trabalhos após o terremoto, no entanto, tem uma visão diferente.

Segundo ele, o governo federal tentou administrar a crise basicamente por conta própria, sem envolver adequadamente os governos locais e provinciais. Isso é particularmente significativo porque o Partido Rastriya Swatantra, do presidente Shah, não tem representação nos governos locais ou provinciais.

Pokharel também questionou se a falta de experiência do governo teria afetado a capacidade de avaliar a magnitude da resposta necessária.

"Nossos países vizinhos, como a China e a Índia, estavam dispostos a oferecer ajuda para o resgate, especialmente para o resgate no túnel, desde o início", pontua ele à DW, acrescentando que o governo não conseguiu decidir a tempo se permitiria que eles entrassem em ação, o que custou três dias cruciais.

Balendra Shah, ex-rapper e compositor que atualmente ocupa o cargo de prefeito de Catmandu, popularmente conhecido como “Balen”. — Foto: Stringer/Reuters

O Nepal afirmou inicialmente que suas próprias equipes de resgate eram capazes de conduzir a operação.

Mas, na sexta-feira (28), o ministro das Relações Exteriores, Shishir Khanal, declarou à imprensa que o governo havia decidido recorrer a especialistas internacionais, inclusive da China e da Índia, para os resgates no túnel, testes de DNA e exames forenses.

Essa mudança apontou uma das principais dúvidas sobre o novo governo: se a gestão de Balen é capaz de agir com rapidez e eficácia durante uma emergência nacional.

De acordo com Pokharel, a capacidade do governo de arrecadar recursos substanciais no país para o auxílio às vítimas demonstrou que há confiança da população.

"Uma coisa positiva é que o governo está arrecadando uma quantia enorme de dinheiro público no país por meio do Fundo de Assistência a Desastres do primeiro-ministro", lembra ele.

"Isso demonstra a confiança da população no governo, que não faz uso indevido dos recursos arrecadados em nome da assistência a desastres."

Até sábado, mais de 5 bilhões de rúpias nepalesas (R$ 179 milhões) haviam sido arrecadados pela gestão de Balendra Shah para as vítimas das enchentes, de acordo com o gabinete do primeiro-ministro e o conselho dos ministros.

Prabha Bogati, vice-prefeita do município de Bidur, no distrito de Nuwakot, afirmou que as autoridades locais tiveram margem de manobra limitada para agir durante a crise, pois o governo federal adotou uma abordagem centralizada do tipo "balcão único", exigindo que as atividades de assistência fossem coordenadas por meio de uma única estrutura de comando.

"Em crises anteriores, comunidades locais e voluntários costumavam ser mobilizados para as operações de busca, resgate e assistência humanitária", conta ela à DW.

Para Bogati, os resgates por helicóptero têm sido eficazes, mas as partes interessadas locais não foram envolvidas na reação e não tiveram permissão para recuperar os corpos ou realizar rituais fúnebres.

O porta-voz do governo e ministro da Educação, Sasmit Pokharel, defendeu a resposta do governo, afirmando que todos os recursos disponíveis estavam sendo mobilizados para as operações de resgate, assistência e reabilitação.

"Na primeira fase, nossa prioridade foi salvar a vida dos cidadãos, utilizando os recursos humanos e os meios disponíveis", disse Pokharel aos repórteres. "Também demos início a um processo para organizar melhor a mobilização dos voluntários."

Em seguida, as imagens registram a contagem regressiva, o momento do lançamento e a comemoração da equipe após a decolagem. O vídeo também mostra, em detalhes e de perto, a partida do foguete.

InnoSpace divulga vídeo do teste com foguete Sebit em Alcântara, no MA — Foto: Reprodução/InnoSpace

Segundo a InnoSpace, o Sebit teve a ignição e a decolagem realizadas normalmente. Durante o voo, porém, foi identificado um desvio em relação ao caminho previsto, e a operação foi encerrada de acordo com os procedimentos de segurança adotados pelo Centro de Lançamento.

A empresa informou que, apesar da interrupção, o teste permitiu a coleta de dados importantes sobre sistemas do foguete e da operação de lançamento, incluindo a plataforma de lançamento, o sistema de propulsão, os sistemas de orientação, navegação e controle (GNC) e os equipamentos de rastreamento.

Os dados obtidos durante a missão serão analisados pela equipe da InnoSpace para avaliar o desempenho do veículo, identificar ajustes necessários e aprimorar a confiabilidade e a estabilidade operacional do Sebit para futuros voos.

"O voo terminou, mas o teste continua por meio dos dados", afirmou a empresa em comunicado divulgado após a missão.

A InnoSpace agradeceu aos integrantes da equipe que participaram da operação no Brasil e aos apoiadores que acompanharam o desenvolvimento do projeto. A companhia afirmou que seguirá trabalhando na análise dos resultados e no aperfeiçoamento do foguete.

O Sebit é um foguete suborbital multifuncional desenvolvido pela empresa sul-coreana como parte de seus projetos para ampliar o acesso a serviços de lançamento espacial.

Voo interrompido após veículo desviar da trajetória prevista

O voo de teste do foguete suborbital SEBIT , lançado no Centro de Lançamento de Alcântara (CLA), no litoral do Maranhão, foi interrompido após o veículo desviar da trajetória prevista.

Em nota, a empresa informou que o foguete decolou normalmente às 16h30 (horário de Brasília), mas apresentou movimentos fora da rota planejada durante o voo. Com isso, a Força Aérea Brasileira (FAB) acionou o Sistema de Terminação de Voo (FTS, na sigla em inglês) por segurança.

O voo foi encerrado cerca de 35 segundos após a decolagem . Segundo a empresa, o foguete caiu dentro de uma zona de segurança marítima previamente designada , sem que fossem registrados feridos ou danos às instalações.

Segundo a empresa sul-coreana, apesar de o voo não ter sido concluído, foram coletados dados importantes dos sistemas de propulsão, navegação e da plataforma de lançamento, que agora serão analisados para identificar a causa do problema.

➡️ Esta foi a primeira operação de lançamento de um dispositivo no local desde a explosão do HANBIT-Nano, em dezembro de 2025 .

Foguete sul-coreano é lançado no Maranhão quase oito meses após explosão, mas voo é interrompido — Foto: Divulgação/Innospace

O lançamento do SEBIT marcou o primeiro contrato comercial da ALADA (Empresa de Projetos Aeroespaciais do Brasil S.A.). Criada pelo governo federal em junho de 2025, a empresa estatal atua no desenvolvimento de projetos aeroespaciais e na exploração comercial dos centros de lançamento brasileiros.

Em comunicado aos acionistas, o diretor-presidente da InnoSpace, Kim Soo-jong, informou que o material coletado está sendo analisado para confirmar a altitude alcançada pelo foguete, a distância percorrida e a duração do voo, além de ajudar a identificar a causa da interrupção da missão.

A empresa afirmou que os resultados da análise serão incorporados ao desenvolvimento do SEBIT para orientar ajustes e aumentar a confiabilidade e a estabilidade do foguete. Segundo a InnoSpace, as conclusões também serão divulgadas aos acionistas após o fim da investigação.

Novo lançamento segue previsto para novembro

A InnoSpace informou que mantém os preparativos para uma nova tentativa de lançamento do HANBIT-Nano em novembro de 2026, também a partir de Alcântara. A companhia afirmou que segurança e confiabilidade serão prioridades durante a preparação.

O HANBIT-Nano já havia sido lançado de Alcântara em 22 de dezembro de 2025 , mas apresentou uma "anomalia" segundos após a decolagem e se desintegrou no ar, segundo relatório divulgado pela InnoSpace. O acidente não deixou feridos.

A investigação apontou que o problema começou com uma falha de vedação na câmara de combustão . Cerca de 33 segundos após o lançamento, houve vazamento de gases de combustão, que provocou a ruptura da estrutura e levou à perda do foguete.

A data exata do lançamento ainda depende da conclusão de etapas técnicas, operacionais e regulatórias. As condições meteorológicas e os requisitos de segurança de voo também serão considerados.

📍 Por que o lançamento será feito em Alcântara?

O lançamento será realizado no Centro de Lançamento de Alcântara (CLA), no litoral do Maranhão. A localização é estratégica por estar próxima à Linha do Equador , condição que favorece determinados tipos de lançamentos e pode reduzir o consumo de combustível .

📍 Quanto mais próximo da Linha do Equador, maior é a velocidade de rotação da superfície da Terra . Essa velocidade pode ser aproveitada pelo foguete durante o lançamento, reduzindo a quantidade de combustível necessária para alcançar determinadas órbitas.

🎐 Além disso, Alcântara oferece condições para diferentes inclinações de órbita e possui uma área com baixa densidade populacional no entorno do centro de lançamento, características que favorecem a segurança das operações.

articles.title: Setembro começa com ciclone na costa do Sul e frio que ganha força | G1
articles.standfirst: Frente fria espalha chuva pelo Centro-Sul nesta terça-feira (1º) e derruba as temperaturas nos próximos dias. Em São Paulo, rajadas podem chegar a 70 km/h. Setembro também deve ter chuva acima da média em parte do Sul, Sudeste e Centro-Oeste.
articles.summary: Frente fria espalha chuva pelo Centro-Sul nesta terça-feira (1º) e derruba as temperaturas. Setembro também deve ter chuva acima da média em parte do Sul, Sudeste e Centro-Oeste.
articles.body:
Pedestres enfrentam dia de frio e chuva na região da Avenida Paulista, em São Paulo, nesta manhã de sexta-feira, 16 de junho de 2023. A temperatura na capital paulista varia de 11 a 18ºC hoje. — Foto: RONALDO SILVA/PHOTO

Setembro começa com a formação de um novo ciclone extratropical no oceano, na costa da Região Sul.

O sistema ajuda a organizar uma frente fria que espalha chuva pelo Sul, Sudeste e parte do Centro-Oeste já nesta terça-feira (1º). Na sequência, as temperaturas caem e o frio ganha força nos próximos dias, principalmente no Sul e em áreas do Sudeste.

🌀 ENTENDA: Os ciclones extratropicais são sistemas de baixa pressão atmosférica – regiões causadoras de tempo adverso em grande escala – que surgem normalmente em latitudes médias. Eles são formados pelo contraste de temperaturas de diferentes massas de ar (quente e fria).

A mudança ocorre depois de um fim de agosto marcado por calor intenso em várias partes do país.

Agora, a combinação de chuva, uma maior presença de nuvens e a entrada de ar frio derruba as temperaturas no Centro-Sul, ao mesmo tempo em que áreas do Norte e do Nordeste continuam sob calor e tempo mais seco.

Segundo a Climatempo, setembro ainda deve ter novos episódios de frio, chuva mais frequente em algumas áreas e picos de calor no centro-norte do país.

O mês marca a transição do período mais seco para o começo da estação chuvosa em boa parte do Brasil. A primavera começa no dia 22, mas Setembro ainda pode ter características típicas do inverno , como novas entradas de ar frio, quedas acentuadas de temperatura e até episódios de geada no Sul.

A chuva deve ficar acima da média em quase toda a Região Sul, no Sudeste, em boa parte do Centro-Oeste, no Tocantins, no sudeste do Pará e em áreas da Bahia, do Maranhão e do Piauí.

Nos primeiros dez dias do mês, inclusive, pancadas podem alcançar regiões que passaram boa parte do inverno sob tempo seco.

No Sul, apesar da previsão de novos episódios de chuva forte ao longo de setembro, o Paraná deve concentrar os maiores volumes.

Já partes do centro-sul do Rio Grande do Sul podem terminar o mês com chuva abaixo da média, depois de um julho e um agosto bastante chuvosos.

No Sudeste, a tendência também é de maior frequência de chuva em comparação com setembro do ano passado. São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro e o centro-sul de Minas Gerais devem ter mais períodos de nebulosidade e passagem de frentes frias, o que ajuda a limitar o calor em vários momentos do mês.

Como ficam as chuvas em setembro — Foto: Arte/g1

Já as temperaturas tendem a ficar próximas ou abaixo da média no Sul, em São Paulo, no Rio de Janeiro, no centro-sul de Minas Gerais e em partes de Mato Grosso do Sul.

Mesmo assim, ainda podem ocorrer dias de calor forte entre uma frente fria e outra.

No Norte, Nordeste e em boa parte do Centro-Oeste, o calor deve continuar sendo um dos destaques de setembro.

Temperaturas acima dos 40°C são comuns nesta época do ano em áreas do centro-norte do país e podem voltar a ocorrer ao longo do mês.

O frio, porém, ainda deve chamar atenção. A Climatempo prevê uma queda mais acentuada das temperaturas já no primeiro fim de semana de setembro, com possibilidade de geada nos três estados do Sul.

Como ficam as temperaturas em setembro — Foto: Arte/g1

Nesta terça-feira, o novo ciclone extratropical se forma no oceano, perto da costa do Sul. O sistema se afasta gradualmente para o Atlântico, mas ajuda a organizar a frente fria que passa pelo Centro-Sul e mantém áreas de chuva em uma faixa extensa do país.

No Sul, o dia começa com pancadas de chuva no Paraná, em Santa Catarina e no leste do Rio Grande do Sul.

Ao longo da tarde, a chuva perde força em boa parte do território gaúcho, mas ainda pode atingir o leste de Santa Catarina e do Paraná.

Segundo a Climatempo, as rajadas de vento podem ficar entre 50 e 70 km/h em várias áreas dos três estados. Em trechos do litoral sul de Santa Catarina e do litoral norte do Rio Grande do Sul, os ventos podem chegar perto dos 90 km/h.

O mar também permanece agitado entre os dois estados.

No Sudeste, a frente fria avança por São Paulo e encontra uma atmosfera ainda aquecida, condição que favorece chuva forte, rajadas de vento e possibilidade localizada de granizo.

Em São Paulo (SP), a chuva aumenta já durante a manhã e pode continuar em diferentes momentos do dia. A máxima fica perto dos 21°C, bem abaixo das temperaturas registradas no fim de semana.

Temperaturas mínimas previstas para esta terça em todo o Brasil. — Foto: CPTEC/Inpe

No Rio de Janeiro (RJ), a nebulosidade aumenta e as pancadas ganham força no decorrer do dia. Belo Horizonte (MG) ainda começa a terça com tempo mais quente, mas também pode ter chuva forte e trovoadas durante a tarde.

No Centro-Oeste, Mato Grosso do Sul é uma das áreas que primeiro sentem os efeitos da frente fria. A chuva aumenta desde o começo do dia e pode ser forte em alguns pontos. Também há previsão de pancadas no sul de Goiás e em partes de Mato Grosso.

Campo Grande (MS) pode ter chuva desde a madrugada e risco de temporais durante a tarde. Cuiabá (MT), por outro lado, ainda terá calor forte, com máxima perto dos 36°C, apesar do aumento da chance de chuva.

O Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia ( Inmet ) prevê que os maiores acumulados desta primeira semana de setembro fiquem concentrados principalmente em Santa Catarina, no norte do Rio Grande do Sul e no oeste do Paraná, onde os volumes podem superar os 100 mm.

Em São Paulo, os maiores totais devem se concentrar no leste e em áreas centrais do estado.

Depois da passagem da frente fria, uma massa de ar mais frio e seco avança pelo Sul e ajuda a derrubar ainda mais as temperaturas a partir de quarta-feira.

Curitiba (PR) pode registrar mínima de cerca de 6°C na quarta-feira, e Porto Alegre (RS), de 8°C. As máximas também ficam baixas: não devem passar muito dos 20°C nas capitais da região.

Em São Paulo (SP), a quarta-feira também será mais fria. A mínima pode chegar aos 12°C, com máxima perto dos 19°C, segundo a previsão. A chuva perde força gradualmente, mas o leste paulista ainda pode ter bastante nebulosidade.

A partir de quinta-feira (3), o tempo tende a ficar mais firme em boa parte de São Paulo, e as temperaturas começam a subir lentamente.

A mudança, porém, deve durar pouco. A Climatempo prevê a aproximação de uma nova frente fria pelo Sul na sexta-feira (4), quando há possibilidade de retorno da chuva a São Paulo entre a noite de sexta e o fim de semana.

No Norte, o começo de setembro segue com predomínio de calor e tempo seco em grande parte da região.

A chuva fica mais concentrada no oeste e no norte do Amazonas e em Roraima, com pancadas isoladas também no Acre, em Rondônia e no noroeste do Pará.

No Nordeste, o tempo firme também predomina no interior. As principais áreas de chuva ficam próximas do litoral, entre Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Pernambuco e Alagoas.

articles.summary: Curso reúne aulas teóricas e atividades práticas de primeiros socorros e combate a princípios de incêndio; mais de 350 pessoas se inscreveram.
articles.body:
Alunos terão aulas de primeiros socorros e combate a princípios de incêndio — Foto: Arquivo Secom

A Defesa Civil de Macaé iniciou uma nova turma do Programa de Formação de Voluntários, voltado à preparação de moradores para atuar na prevenção de riscos e no apoio à população em situações de emergência.

A formação registrou recorde de procura, com mais de 350 inscrições. Foram disponibilizadas 150 vagas para moradores de Macaé com mais de 18 anos, preenchidas por ordem de inscrição.

O curso será realizado na modalidade semipresencial, combinando conteúdos teóricos online e atividades práticas obrigatórias. Os participantes terão aulas sobre primeiros socorros e combate a princípios de incêndio, além de treinamentos para atuação preventiva e resposta a ocorrências.

Voluntários capacitados ajudarão a multiplicar orientações de segurança nas comunidades — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

A primeira atividade prática está prevista para o dia 16 de setembro, na Cidade Universitária, na Granja dos Cavaleiros, com treinamento de primeiros socorros. No dia 23 de setembro, os alunos participarão da prática de combate a princípios de incêndio, no Centro de Convenções Jornalista Roberto Marinho, em São José do Barreto. As duas atividades estão previstas para começar às 18h.

A proposta é ampliar a rede de pessoas capacitadas para auxiliar a Defesa Civil em ações educativas, preventivas e de apoio durante emergências. Os voluntários também poderão contribuir para disseminar informações sobre percepção de riscos e medidas de segurança nas comunidades.

articles.title: "He doesn’t make her smile like Charlie did": Candace Owens’ nostalgic Charlie Kirk post sparks controversy over her relationship with her husband
articles.summary: US Streamers News: Candace Owens has reignited attention around her relationship with the late Charlie Kirk after sharing a nostalgic photo of the conservative activist .
articles.body: Candace Owens has reignited attention around her relationship with the late Charlie Kirk after sharing a nostalgic photo of the conservative activist on social media. Her simple message about memories that still make her smile quickly became the target of a personal online jab. Instead of focusing only on Owens’ remembrance, one post turned the conversation toward her marriage to George Farmer and questioned the nature of their relationship.Candace Owens looks back on memories with Charlie KirkOwens shared an old photo of herself with Kirk, who died last year. The picture shows the two smiling for the camera while wearing leis, capturing a much lighter moment from their years in conservative media.Her caption was short and emotional:“So many memories that make me smile now. ✝️”The post immediately stood out because of the history between Owens and Kirk. Their professional relationship dates back years, with Kirk playing a significant role in bringing Owens into the Turning Point USA orbit. For a period, the two were prominent figures within the same conservative movement and frequently appeared together at events and in political media.Their friendship later became a subject of intense public discussion, particularly after Kirk's death. Owens has spoken openly about the importance of their friendship and the memories they shared, making the throwback photo feel deeply personal rather than simply political.But the reaction to her post quickly moved in another direction.One social media account used Owens’ nostalgic message to question why she appears to share memories involving Kirk while allegedly posting less about her husband, George Farmer.The post read:“Candace Owens never wakes up and posts a picture with her husband.I guess he doesn’t make her smile like Charlie did.Maybe it’s because they have no real connection and she agreed to marry him before ever going on a single date.Idk 🤷‍♀️ just asking questions...”The wording was deliberately provocative. It attempted to turn a sentimental post about a late friend into speculation about Owens’ personal life.Candace Owens’ marriage becomes the focus of online criticismThe post also revived attention around how quickly Owens and Farmer's relationship developed. The couple met through conservative political circles, became engaged relatively soon afterward and married in 2019. They have since welcomed children together and maintained a public family life.That history makes the claim about their relationship more complicated than the social media post suggests. The account offered an interpretation of Owens’ marriage, but the post itself does not establish that she and Farmer lack a genuine connection.Still, the timing of the criticism is significant.Owens has remained at the center of controversy since Kirk's death, particularly because of her public clashes with Erika Kirk, his widow. Their dispute has generated widespread attention and placed Owens’ past friendship with Kirk under even greater scrutiny.As a result, a photograph that might once have been viewed as a simple throwback now carries a much heavier context.Owens’ caption did not mention her husband, her marriage or the controversies surrounding Kirk. She simply shared a memory that she said still makes her smile. Yet the response shows how difficult it has become for her to discuss Kirk without the conversation expanding into questions about their friendship, his death and her personal relationships.For Owens, the post appeared to be about remembering someone from an important chapter of her life. articles.title: Roughly 80 Americans still unaccounted for after Himalayan disaster kills 903, officials say
articles.summary: Nepal and China's death toll climbed to 903 as roughly 4,200 people remained unaccounted for following the devastating flood and debris flow.
articles.body: Roughly 80 Americans remain unaccounted for following the catastrophic Himalayan flood last Wednesday that killed hundreds of people, the State Department said. The update marks a decrease from a previous estimate of at least 90 Americans who went missing near the Nepal-China border. "We can confirm that 13 American citizens have made their way to safety in Nepal," a State Department spokesperson told Fox News. Meanwhile, Nepal’s death toll has risen to 903, while the number of people still unaccounted for has nearly doubled to roughly 4,200, according to an update from local officials Sunday. TRAPPED NEPALI WORKERS PULLED FROM HYDROPOWER TUNNEL AFTER CATASTROPHIC FLOODING According to officials, the disaster occurred in north-central Nepal when a distant slope failure involving a glacier triggered a rapidly moving debris flow that traveled roughly 62 miles downstream before striking a populated area. Footage from the disaster showed a massive surge of water and debris suddenly rushing through the valleys, engulfing buildings in its path. On Sunday, a spokesperson for Nepal’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs provided an update on the toll. "So far, 903 bodies have been recovered from the areas and about 4200 people are still unaccounted for. Over 10,000 people have been rescued from the regions, including over 323 foreign nationals. As per the available data, about 590 foreign nationals are still missing, from 39 countries," the spokesperson said. Twenty-two of the missing Americans were part of a pilgrimage affiliated with a Tennessee-based nonprofit group, Isha Foundation coordination leader Jyoti Jankowski told Fox News Saturday. They were inside an immigration building when the flooding struck the area, Jankowski said. MORE THAN 3,000 MISSING AFTER COLOMBIA EARTHQUAKE AS TRUMP ADMINISTRATION PROVIDES $15.5 MILLION IN RELIEF Authorities said Nepal is coordinating with neighboring countries and the international community to provide relief, with supplies already arriving from countries including India and China. articles.title: Five years after Saied’s power grab, Tunisia’s old grievances resurface
articles.summary: Economic grievances persist while space for dissent has narrowed under President Kais Saied.
articles.body:
Tunis, Tunisia – More than 15 years after Tunisians rose up to topple longtime President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, familiar grievances are again being heard on the streets from north to south.

A slogan from the 2011 revolution is being heard again: “employment, freedom and national dignity”.

This time, those demands are being fuelled by water cuts, electricity outages, rising prices, medicine shortages and a struggle to make ends meet, problems increasingly affecting Tunisians across social and economic divides.

But the anger is unfolding in a very different political environment.

The discontent comes as Tunisia marks five years since President Kais Saied suspended parliament, dismissed the government and began ruling by decree, moves he described as necessary to end years of political paralysis and corruption.

Many Tunisians welcomed the move at the time, frustrated with a political system that had failed to address the country’s economic problems after the 2011 revolution.

Five years later, many of those grievances remain while the political space for challenging those in power has narrowed sharply.

The decade that followed Ben Ali’s ouster brought competitive elections and greater space for political parties and civil society, but it also brought frequent government changes, political disputes and little improvement in the lives of many Tunisians.

Unemployment remained high, particularly among young people and in the country’s interior. Public services remained weak while rising prices continued to put pressure on household incomes. By the end of 2020, unemployment stood at 17.4 percent, according to the World Bank.

Tunisia also faced serious security threats, including attacks and political assassinations, adding to economic pressures and hitting sectors such as tourism.

Those frustrations helped Saied build support as an outsider promising to break with the traditional political establishment and what many Tunisians saw as a dysfunctional system.

On July 25, 2021, Saied suspended the Assembly of the Representatives of the People, dismissed Prime Minister Hichem Mechichi and lifted parliamentary immunity. He said he was acting to address a national crisis.

His opponents described the move as a coup.

Saied later dissolved parliament and oversaw the adoption of a new constitution in 2022 that significantly strengthened presidential powers.

Since then, opposition figures, journalists, lawyers and activists have been jailed or prosecuted in cases that rights groups describe as politically motivated. Civil society has faced increasing restrictions while critics have said institutional checks on presidential power have been weakened. Human Rights Watch, for example, has described the “conspiracy case” as part of a broader crackdown on dissent.

The case centres on allegations by Tunisian authorities that opposition politicians, lawyers, activists and other public figures were involved in a conspiracy against state security and sought to destabilise the country and undermine the government. The defendants included figures from different parts of the political spectrum.

In April 2025, a Tunis court sentenced 37 defendants to prison terms ranging from four to 66 years. Human Rights Watch described the case as politically motivated and criticised the trial for failing to provide adequate due-process protections.

On November 27, 2025, a Tunis appeals court upheld convictions against 34 of the 37 defendants, sentencing them to between five and 45 years in prison, and acquitted three.

Human Rights Watch and other rights groups continued to criticise the proceedings and describe the case as part of a wider crackdown on dissent.

The authorities reject those accusations and maintain that the defendants were prosecuted for serious offences against state security.

But the political transformation has yet to produce the economic turnaround Saied promised.

Many of Tunisia’s economic problems predate Saied. Years of underinvestment, financial pressures and ageing infrastructure have left public utilities and other state services struggling to meet demand.

But those failures have become harder to separate from Saied’s record because he came to power promising that a stronger state could overcome the weaknesses of the old political system.

This summer, temperatures approached 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) in parts of Tunisia, pushing electricity demand to record levels. Kairouan reached 49.8C (121.6F) on Thursday, according to the Tunisian Observatory for Weather and Climate. The Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas introduced rotating power cuts in several regions, and the outages affected water-pumping stations in some areas.

Some people reported going days without running water. Bottled water shortages added to the pressure. Long queues formed outside shops and water trucks delivering supplies to some areas.

For Rebh, a 40-year-old cleaner from Tunis, the demands are not about luxuries but about being able to afford and access the basics of everyday life.

“People are tired. They are choosing to cross the sea and die [trying to reach Europe] instead. I hope we can stand together and find a solution now,” she told Al Jazeera. “We are not asking for the impossible. This is about water and electricity. We want to live as humans. We are feeling dead while we’re still alive.”

For many Tunisians, the shortages are part of a broader squeeze on purchasing power that has made it increasingly difficult to afford basic necessities.

The extreme heat has also put pressure on an already strained health system as doctors warned of increased pressure on emergency departments.

The point, however, is not that Saied created Tunisia’s economic problems. He did not.

The question is whether the more centralised system he built has delivered the more effective government he promised.

For journalist Manel Derbali, the change has been visible not only in the media but in the wider public space.

After the 2011 revolution, she said, Tunisians gained a new ability to speak openly and access information. Despite the protests and political turmoil of the period, journalists felt they were not alone in challenging those in power.

“After years of censorship and police repression, everything opened up. The journalist felt that the street was with you in one way or another,” Derbali said.

She said journalists also had channels to raise concerns about their working conditions and make proposals to officials, including through parliament and ministries, while access to decision-makers remained possible.

“After July 25, all of these spaces became closed,” she said.

Derbali said journalists now struggle to obtain even basic responses from government institutions with official bodies sometimes leaving requests unanswered for months.

“Unfortunately, history is repeating itself, and we have returned to relying on citizens’ videos to investigate and verify information,” she said.

Her account reflects a broader concern among critics of Saied that the institutions and public spaces that emerged after the revolution have been steadily weakened.

The current protests are not limited to Tunisia’s traditional opposition.

The Nafas movement, which has organised recent demonstrations in Tunis, seeks to bring together political parties and independent figures beyond the country’s established opposition to Saied. Its protests have also attracted citizens who had not previously taken part in political demonstrations.

Rabii Qassem, a member of the Nafas collective, said comparisons between the past five years and the decade after the revolution should not be reduced to whether Tunisia was simply better or worse before Saied.

“I’m not saying that Tunisia between 2011 and 2021 was paradise,” he said. “There were very serious crises: unemployment, corruption, economic fragility, political conflicts and a failure to achieve a large part of the revolution’s goals.”

But according to Qassem, that period also brought gains, including greater freedom of expression and protest, a stronger civil society, a more diverse media and elections that allowed for peaceful transfers of power.

“After July 25, the economic and social problems that already existed were not solved,” he said. “They were joined by a decline in political checks and balances, freedoms and the space for civil society.”

For Qassem, many of the demands raised in 2011 remain unresolved.

“Where is employment? Where is the water? Where are the public services? Where is the dignity?” he asked.

He said economic hardship and political repression have been increasingly feeding into each other as people struggling with rising prices and deteriorating services have also found fewer avenues to express their frustration.

That does not mean Tunisia is experiencing another 2011.

Many Tunisians remain wary of the political parties and politicians who dominated the decade after Ben Ali while Saied continues to have supporters who blame that period for years of economic stagnation and political instability.

Nor does every person angry about a water cut, electricity outage or rising price necessarily oppose the president.

But the protests show how economic and political grievances can increasingly overlap.

Before 2021, Tunisians could blame a democratic political system they saw as ineffective for failing to improve their lives.

After 2021, Saied dismantled much of that system and promised that a stronger presidency would deliver better government.

Five years later, many of the same grievances remain.

The difference is that the avenues for challenging them have become narrower.

“Employment, freedom and national dignity” was a demand of the revolution that ended Ben Ali’s rule.

Fifteen years later, Tunisians are again asking for jobs, basic services and greater freedoms – but now from a president who came to power promising to address the failures of the system that followed the revolution.

articles.title: Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis found guilty in Tupac Shakur’s 1996 killing
articles.summary: Jurors heard nearly two weeks of testimony from dozens of former investigators and law enforcement officers involved in solving the 30-year mystery.
articles.body: The man accused of orchestrating rapper Tupac Shakur’s killing was convicted Monday of first-degree murder with use of a deadly weapon in the 1996 Las Vegas slaying. Following a nearly two-week trial, jurors unanimously found Duane “Keffe D” Davis, 63, guilty of the murder that for nearly 30 years has gripped rap fans, true-crime experts and conspiracy theorists alike. Clark County prosecutors had argued that Davis was a “shotcaller” for the South Side Compton Crips in Los Angeles and that he sought revenge on Shakur after he attacked Davis’ nephew. Davis was not accused of pulling the trigger, but under Nevada law, someone who helps another person commit murder can be convicted of the crime. Davis is the only person alive who rode in the same car as the shooter 30 years ago, prosecutors said. Davis, dressed in all black, stood silently next to his counsel as the verdict was read. He took a seat, hands clasped on the table in front of him, as the jurors were polled one by one, each affirming the guilty verdict. Sekyiwa “Set” Shakur, Tupac’s sister, cried and reached back to a person behind her. Davis’ son covered his face with one hand, The Associated Press reported. District Judge Carli Kierny ordered Davis, who faces a life sentence, to remain in jail until his Oct. 13 sentencing. Davis indicated he intends to file an appeal. Shakur, who was 25 when he died, was revered as one of the most influential rappers of all time and continues to bring in new generations of listeners. The prosecution said Monday that the state would dismiss the gang enhancement part of the charge because of witness logistics. Chief Deputy District Attorney Binu Palal said in his closing statement that Davis “went hunting” for Shakur and Death Row Records co-founder Marion “Suge” Knight after they were spotted at the MGM Grand Hotel beating up Orlando “Baby Lane” Anderson, also known as the “prince” of Compton in California because of his relationship to Davis. Jurors watched grainy VHS security video and heard multiple former law enforcement officers testify about the fight that broke out a few hours before Shakur and Knight were wounded in a drive-by shooting. Knight survived his injuries, but Shakur died six days later. In 2008, Davis entered into an agreement with federal investigators who were looking into the death of Marion Wallace, the rapper known as Notorious B.I.G. Davis believed the deal, called a proffer, gave him immunity, but he was not shielded from future prosecution if he confessed to being involved in Shakur’s murder. Because of the proffer, Davis described details of Shakur’s killing that only a witness could provide, Bilal said. They included the positions of people inside the car in the drive-by shooting and previous gang fights that culminated in Shakur’s death. Davis’ 2019 memoir, “Compton Street Legend,” was the final piece of evidence needed to convict him, Bilal said. In the book, Davis writes that he played a role in Shakur’s murder, and its publication prompted a renewed investigation into Shakur’s killing. “For nearly 18 years, Duane Davis has told the police, television, books, YouTube interviewers, anybody that will listen,” Bilal said in his closing statement. “He has told you he is responsible for the murder of Tupac Shakur. Tell him you hear him. Find him guilty.” Defense attorney Michael Sanft argued that Davis fabricated or embellished his accounts of the killing for money and notoriety and that investigators failed to independently corroborate his claims. During his closing, Sanft repeatedly pointed to a lack of physical evidence that could place his client at the crime scene. Detectives never found records — including receipts, phone logs or photos — that proved Davis was in Las Vegas at the same time as Shakur or that he provided the gun used to kill him. Retired Las Vegas homicide detective Dan Long, the defense’s final witness, testified that he tried unsuccessfully to verify several details Davis provided during a 2009 police interview, Sanft argued. “When you think about Mr. Davis’ statements, they all conflict,” Sanft said in his closing statement. “They conflict with the book, and they conflict with the past. And the only thing that we have is that we can agree on is that Tupac Shakur was shot and killed on Sept. 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, Nevada.” Shakur’s killing triggered a decadeslong investigation that took Las Vegas investigators from the Strip to Compton, near Los Angeles, where rival gangs were embroiled in a violent war that erupted immediately after Shakur was shot. Uncooperative witnesses and conflicting statements made it difficult for police to draw a straight line from Las Vegas to Compton, where everyone associated with the shooting lived, officials testified. Las Vegas detectives traveled to Southern California a dozen times and were continually stymied by unreliable informants and a culture of silence, former law enforcement officers testified. “I think it made the case more difficult, and I think the 30 years made the case more difficult, as well,” Sanft told reporters last week.

articles.title: Clavicular faces fresh backlash as Chapel Hill venue cancels planned appearance
articles.summary: US Streamers News: A planned Chapel Hill appearance by controversial influencer Clavicular has been canceled after growing community opposition and calls for a protest. .
articles.body: A planned Chapel Hill appearance by controversial influencer Clavicular has been canceled after growing community opposition and calls for a protest. The 20-year-old internet personality, whose real name is Braden Peters, had been scheduled to appear at Still Life on East Franklin Street on August 30. The decision came just days after his appearance at a Raleigh nightclub drew attention across the Triangle.Why the Clavicular event was canceled in Chapel HillStill Life announced the cancellation on Saturday, saying the decision followed feedback from the community. The club also made its priority clear, stating, “safety of our customers, staff and community will always come first.”The cancellation came as flyers appeared around downtown Chapel Hill urging people to protest Peters' planned appearance. His visit was part of what he has described as a college tour, with stops planned around the country.The controversy surrounding Clavicular goes well beyond his online persona. Peters has built a large audience on TikTok, Instagram and Kick by promoting looksmaxxing, an internet trend centered on changing one's appearance to become more attractive.Some of the methods associated with Peters have been extreme. His online content has included claims and demonstrations involving cosmetic enhancement, so-called bonesmashing and drug use. His image has helped him attract millions of followers, but it has also made him a deeply divisive figure.Peters has also been linked to creators associated with the manosphere and has faced criticism over offensive language used during livestreams.His public profile has been accompanied by legal and personal controversies as well. He was arrested in Florida in March on battery charges that were later dropped. In April, he was hospitalized following an apparent overdose that was reportedly captured on livestream.He is also facing a civil lawsuit involving an allegation of sexual battery against a minor. The allegations in that case have not been established as fact.Clavicular's Raleigh appearance adds to Triangle controversyThe Chapel Hill cancellation came only two days after Peters appeared at The Village nightclub on Glenwood Avenue in Raleigh on August 28.That appearance had already generated discussion in the local community. Milk Man Promotions, which promoted the Raleigh event, said it worked with the Raleigh Police Department to arrange additional officers for the appearance.The promoter's owner, identified as “JZ,” defended the decision to host Peters and dismissed concerns about the controversy surrounding him.“There is no such thing as bad publicity,” Milk Man Promotions owner “JZ” told McLaughlin. “If you’re upset, it’s not for everybody. If you don’t want to see Clav, don’t come.”That stance contrasts sharply with the decision made by Still Life in Chapel Hill. While the Raleigh event went ahead, the Chapel Hill club ultimately chose to cancel after hearing from members of the community.The contrasting responses highlight the difficult position venues can face when booking internet personalities whose large audiences can bring attention, while their histories and online conduct can also trigger strong opposition.For now, Peters' Triangle tour has already produced two very different outcomes. His Raleigh appearance moved forward with additional security, while the planned Chapel Hill event was scrapped before it could take place. articles.title: Newspaper headlines: 'Kemi gets Tories battle ready' and 'Posh makes some dosh'
articles.summary: A Tory frontbench reshuffle and Victoria Beckham making "some dosh" lead some of Tuesday's papers.
articles.body:
A number of the papers look forward to Andy Burnham's first parliamentary appearance as prime minister.

The Guardian says his statement to MPs will "drive home" his pledge to bring more essential services back into public control. The paper has spoken to a Downing Street source who says Burnham's statement will be all about proving that he can "bring back hope". The Sun says this marks the end of the prime minister's "honeymoon", and says now he will have to deliver on Britain's real problems of "welfare, a flatlining economy" and defence.

Some hints on the government's plans for that last issue are in the Times where the Chancellor, John Healey, says he will set out a "clear path" to spending 3% of national income on defence in the Spring. But he warns that will mean "difficult" decisions in the Budget this autumn.

Kemi Badenoch's shake-up of her Conservative shadow cabinet over the Bank Holiday weekend is hailed as a "ruthless reshuffle" by the Daily Mail , which says she is getting the Tories "ready for battle" amid rumours of an early election. The Financial Times believes Badenoch's first goal should be to restore the Conservatives to their "traditional position" as the country's "major right wing party".

The Daily Express highlights a report backed by the former defence minister, Al Carns, which urges the government to drop its Northern Ireland Troubles Bill over fears it could trap soldiers in "endless legal jeopardy". Carns is quoted as warning that "justice is not served when the process itself becomes the punishment". Ministers say the existing Legacy Act protects terrorists and leaves veterans exposed, while their plans will fix a "broken system".

The Daily Mirror says Ghislaine Maxwell is preparing to "beg" US President Donald Trump for her "freedom". The paper believes it is her "last hope" to end the 20-year prison sentence she is currently serving for procuring girls for Jeffrey Epstein.

Cancer patients receiving immunotherapy could survive for twice as long if they received their treatment in the morning rather than the afternoon, according to research picked up by the Daily Telegraph . It says doctors at The Christie hospital in Manchester found it made the biggest difference for people with skin and lung cancer.

articles.title: African NGOs demand probe into six bodies found in Guinea mass grave
articles.summary: The bodies were found bound and blindfolded in the Forecariah administrative prefecture on August 24.
articles.body:
A group of 20 African civil society organisations has called for an independent investigation into the discovery of six unidentified bodies in a mass grave in Guinea.

The call on Sunday came after local men gathering firewood stumbled upon the six male bodies in the village of Alassoya in Lower Guinea’s Forecariah administrative prefecture on August 24.

The bodies were found bound and blindfolded.

Guinea’s Armed Forces have confirmed the discovery.

The NGOs included the Afrikajom Centre and several branches of the Tournons La Page (TLP), an organisation that unites citizens’ movements across a dozen African countries.

They demanded that “all hypotheses be examined as part of an independent, impartial and transparent investigation”. They also called for the investigation to be conducted “with the support of national and international forensic experts in order to formally identify the victims”.

The groups said the discovery of the mass grave comes on top of “at least 35 cases of enforced disappearances documented by TLP-Guinea since September 5, 2021”.

They added that the circumstances in which the bodies were found “raise fears that the victims may have been subjected to extrajudicial, summary or arbitrary executions”.

Guinea’s Armed Forces have promised an inquiry.

The military said in a statement that the six bodies have been transported to the hospital in Forecariah “to proceed with identification and, if possible, determine the circumstances of their deaths”.

It added that “all measures were being taken to shed light” on the discovery and stated that “investigation results will be made public”.

The discovery comes amid a wide-ranging crackdown on dissent in Guinea following General Mamady Doumbouya’s seizure of power in a coup in 2021.

Since the power grab, several political parties have been suspended and protests suppressed, while numerous opposition and civil society leaders have been arrested, sentenced, or forced into exile.

Civil society groups have also documented cases of opposition activists being abducted or disappearing under the military government.

France has also called on Guinean authorities to conduct a transparent and independent investigation into the mass grave, according to Africanews, a news outlet based in the French city of Lyon.

Africanews said another mass grave was found in the same region of Guinea last year, but investigations have yet to determine the identities of the victims or their causes of death.
